record.name: Plain
record.one_liner: Plain is an AI support infrastructure and helpdesk platform for B2B teams featuring a GraphQL API.

auth.notes: API calls use a Bearer token where the token is an API key.

access.notes: Every plan includes a free 7-day trial, with no credit card required.

api_surface.notes: Plain is built on a GraphQL API and provides a TypeScript GraphQL SDK.

mcp.notes: The documentation mentions trying their MCP Server if looking to access the GraphQL API from an Agent.

buildability.reasoning: Credentials are self-serve (api_key) and the pages document a usable API surface. (Derived from access, auth and api_surface.)
